name: Amber Eyes
source:
Tadeusz, a Polish taxi driver, has lived in Danzig his whole life. But that doesn't matter. The true masters of the supposedly free city-state are Germans, and lately, they have been more and more adamant about it. The Slavs are a lesser race, they say, and those of worthier blood were made to rule over them.

Tadeusz has no habit of thinking about his blood. He spends his days spying on a wealthy German businessman he is in love with. His name is Hans and he takes Tadeusz's cab sometimes, and usually, it's a silent ride. If only he could pay more attention to him...

[From [url=https://doksa.itch.io/amber-eyes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
波兰出租车司机塔德乌什一辈子都生活在但泽。但那根本无关紧要——这座名义上的“自由市”真正的主宰者是德国人，而且近来他们对此愈发咄咄逼人。他们宣称斯拉夫人是低等民族，唯有血统高贵之人方配统治他们。

塔德乌什向来没有琢磨自身血统的习惯。他每天的心思全都花在了暗中窥视自己暗恋的一位富有的德国商人身上。那个男人名叫汉斯，偶尔会搭乘塔德乌什的出租车，而一路上往往只有沉默相伴。要是汉斯能多留意他哪怕一点点就好了……
